limitations: Playtest was not run for this Forge effort.
CAD and mesh checks passed; successful printing, physical fit, force, friction, wear, cycle life, safety certification, and human response remain unverified.
Assembly uses a deliberate two-hand raised-root service sequence; everyday operation remains planar through the left wing.
summary: A three-part, hardware-free hand-powered desk toy: sweeping the left wing rotates the meshed pair from a low crescent form toward a moth silhouette with six star apertures.
title: Moon-Moth Bloom
what_arrives: One left wing that serves as the control
One self-contained printed setup and use guide
